verdict.rationale: Open WebUI has no documented sandbox or test-environment feature. Isolation has to be assembled from adjacent capabilities: it is self-hosted and installs easily via pip, Docker or Kubernetes, so a separate non-production instance can be stood up. Agents can also run in one git worktree per task, and tool approval and plan modes gate agent actions before they execute. Missing for 10: a first-party sandbox/staging mode, documented separation of test data from production data, sandboxed code execution guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
